definition: an object or item
sentence: What is this thing?

definition: a particular location or area
sentence: This is a good place to sit.

definition: a route or a method of doing something
sentence: Show me the way to the park.

definition: one piece or portion of a whole
sentence: This is part of the picture.

definition: one surface or edge of something
sentence: Write on this side of the paper.

definition: a thought, suggestion or possible plan
sentence: I have an idea for the poster.

definition: a difficulty that needs a solution
sentence: There is a problem with the wheel.

definition: the cause or explanation for something
sentence: Rain is the reason we stay inside.

definition: what happens because of an action or event
sentence: The broken cup is the result of the fall.

definition: something known to be true
sentence: It is a fact that ice melts when warmed enough.

definition: a particular thing used to show what is meant
sentence: This apple is an example of fruit.

definition: a way in which things are not the same
sentence: Can you see the difference?

definition: an opportunity or possibility
sentence: Everyone has a chance to play.

definition: the act of choosing or the available options
sentence: You have a choice of two drinks.
additionalExamples: You have a choice of two drinks.

definition: the reason why something is done or used
sentence: The purpose of a key is to open a lock.

definition: an instruction about what is allowed or required
sentence: Please follow the rule.

definition: knowledge or skill you get from doing something
sentence: She has experience working in a shop.
context: She has worked in a shop for years.
She has experience serving customers.

definition: ideas about what someone should do
sentence: Can you give me some advice?
usage: some advice / a piece of advice; not an advice
context: Can you give me some advice?

definition: what someone thinks about something
sentence: What is your opinion of this idea?
context: What is your opinion of this idea?

definition: a small piece of information about something
sentence: Please check the delivery details.
context: Please check the delivery details.

definition: how good or bad something is
sentence: The quality of this bag is good.
context: The quality of this bag is good.

definition: how much of something there is
sentence: We need a small amount of water.
context: We need a small amount of water.

definition: being allowed to do something
sentence: You need permission to use this room.
context: You need permission to use this room.

definition: something that happens, especially an organised activity
sentence: The school is holding an event on Friday.
context: The school is holding an event on Friday.

definition: a problem or subject that needs attention
sentence: There is an issue with the payment.
context: There is an issue with the payment.

definition: the way people are connected to each other
sentence: They have a good working relationship.
context: They have a good working relationship.

definition: a way to solve a problem
sentence: We need to find a solution to this problem.
context: We need to find a solution to this problem.

definition: the energy or work needed to do something
sentence: Learning a language takes time and effort.
context: Learning a language takes time and effort.

definition: a chance to do something useful or enjoyable
sentence: This is a good opportunity to practise English.
context: This is a good opportunity to practise English.

definition: something you do often, sometimes without thinking
sentence: Reading before bed is a good habit.
context: Reading before bed is a good habit.

definition: one action in a process
sentence: What is the next step?
context: What is the next step?

definition: something you can choose
sentence: There are two options for delivery.
context: There are two options for delivery.

definition: information and understanding about something
sentence: She has a lot of knowledge about computers.
context: She has a lot of knowledge about computers.

definition: the ability to remember; also, something you remember
sentence: I have a happy memory of that day.
usage: a good memory / a memory of something
context: I have a happy memory of that day.

definition: how much something is worth or how useful it is
sentence: This ticket is good value for money.
context: This ticket is good value for money.

definition: a group of things with similar features
